description:
What we have here is one of the most fun bikes you will probably ever own. A trail ripping long travel singlespeed. The frames accept up to a 150mm travel fork, have internal dropper routing, and feature up to 2.8" 29er tire clearance.

We could offer a couple of stock builds on the Radimus frame - however most folks want a full on custom build so we just build them to customer specs. You get the right bike, the first time, with all the parts you want with no need to upgrade in the future!
